about: How TF2's world maps onto White Knuckle's. One row. The mod measures White Knuckle's gravity and velocity units in flight and keeps TF2 trajectories the same relative to your body: speed scale k = sqrt(g_wk * s / gravityHU), s = WK body height / hullHeightHU (metres per HU).

columns.crouchForceHeightHU: hull height TF2 uses for blast push while crouched
columns.defaultWkGravity: White Knuckle gravity (m/s^2) used until measured in flight
columns.defaultWkVelocityToMetres: White Knuckle vel field to m/s, used until measured
columns.defaultWkBodyHeight: White Knuckle body height (m) used if the character controller can't be read
columns.calibrationSamples: airborne physics steps to measure before trusting the measurement
columns.blastStateMinTime: seconds after a blast before landing ends TF2 air control

rows.source: Source sv_gravity 800, sv_airaccelerate 10, air wishspeed cap 30, sv_maxvelocity 3500; TF2 hull 48x48x82, self-blast crouch hull 55 (tf_player.cpp); WK vel x175 = m/s from senkodev/WKBloodbugMode (MIT); WK gravity default is a guess replaced by in-flight measurement
